reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing the narrow-window Quiet Lens top menu found while repairing #1224
reason: TopBar's Quiet Lens handle revealed on hover and on pointer focus at any width, and its blur handler closed the menu when the phone-width layout hid the focused handle. At 390px with a mouse the menu could not be opened. Hover now uses the side handle's wide-layout query, focus reveals only for :focus-visible, and a self-hide blur is ignored. Selected: TopBar unit tests (new cases fail on main) and the quiet-lens area, which now includes narrow.
exclusions: host-startup-default also maps TopBar.tsx but only checks first-run startup on a real Core; the TopBar layout and startup copy are unchanged. phone-shell, critical-workspaces and the Zero shell journey passed locally on desktop, compact, narrow and all six mobile projects, and a disposable LAN Core run covered narrow mouse, narrow keyboard, desktop hover, and Pixel and iPhone tap.
